_comment: Trap Map: Research-based thesis cards with falsifiable tests. Each trap corresponds to one research piece and tracks validation status. FORBIDDEN: any language about holdings, portfolio positions, share counts, powder, IRA, buy/sell sizing, kill, kill-shot, Vote, Debait tip, or whether 'we' hold the name.

_field_definitions.id: Stable slug identifier for the trap
_field_definitions.title: Short headline for the card
_field_definitions.validation_status: WATCH = live thesis, next named print is the gate; HOLD = goalposts set (thesis language, not a portfolio hold); POUNCE = print flipped the map for investigation (not a buy call); RELEGATE = demoted on the map
_field_definitions.who_collects_rent: Entity/mechanism that captures economic rent first
_field_definitions.leftover: Who gets the residual after rent-collectors clear
_field_definitions.decisive_test: Single stranger-checkable test that validates or falsifies the thesis
_field_definitions.next_datapoint: Optional: { label, expected_date } for tracking upcoming prints
_field_definitions.relegate_if: Conditions under which the thesis should be relegated
_field_definitions.sources: Array of primary source labels (URLs added when available)

status_legend.WATCH: Live thesis — next named print is the gate
status_legend.HOLD: Goalposts set (thesis language, not a portfolio hold)
status_legend.POUNCE: Print flipped the map for investigation (not a buy call)

traps.title: Power + interconnect into data centers
traps.status_note: Sep STEO demand sensor WEAKEN stamped in sources; validation_status remains WATCH.
traps.who_collects_rent: Regulated T&D / FERC transmission owners / mandatory CIAC or DCT collateral / firm capacity or RBP offtake — not uncured queue MW or GPU narrative.
traps.leftover: Hyperscaler or colo equity priced as if watts and interconnect are free; miners without firm PPA or curtailable tariff edge.
traps.decisive_test: Next named print that re-prices who clears the gate: Dominion CIAC tariff text (PUR-2026-00131, ~late Oct 2026), peer DCT asks→binding MW, new PJM IMM/BRA DC-load revenue attribution, or FERC §206 large-load tariff text (≤16 Nov 2026).

next_datapoint.expected_date: CIAC ~late Oct 2026 (PUR-2026-00131); §206 on/before 16 Nov 2026; PJM ER26-3380 order sought by 29 Sep 2026

traps.title: AST SpaceMobile — path-to-profit vs CapEx identity
traps.who_collects_rent: Gateway / government milestone revenue and the CapEx + convert stack that funds constellation build.
traps.leftover: Equity priced as if commercial direct-to-device service is already clearing CapEx multiples.
traps.decisive_test: Q1 2027 Form 10-Q discloses whether approximately 45 BlueBird satellites are in orbit vs Jul 15 2026 8-K early-2027 target.

next_datapoint.label: Next intervening 8-K / IR launch or schedule print; then Q1 2027 10-Q constellation disclosure vs Jul 15 2026 8-K ~45 BlueBirds early 2027

traps.title: ARK Genomic Revolution — theme basket vs first-money prints
traps.status_note: HOLD = thesis goalposts set, not a portfolio hold. This card tracks validation criteria for the genomic-innovation theme, not a position.
traps.who_collects_rent: Platform tools (ILMN/TXG/TWST), reimbursed diagnostics (NTRA/GH/TEM), therapeutic cash (LLY / Vertex-led CASGEVY; CRSP as residual partner).
traps.leftover: Active mid/small genomic ETF sleeve after platform/dx/therapy cash + fee drag + clinical optionality overlap.
traps.decisive_test: ≥2 goalpost prints decide thesis upgrade vs relegate pressure — never a tip: TWST Q4 adj. EBITDA path; TEM–PSNL close track; NTRA/GH guides; gene-edit path (CASGEVY uptake or NTLA BLA acceptance); opposite cluster for relegate pressure.

next_datapoint.label: TWST Q4 FY26 adj. EBITDA print / TEM–PSNL close update / NTLA BLA acceptance window
next_datapoint.expected_date: TWST ~Nov FY26 report; TEM–PSNL late Q4'26–early'27; NTLA acceptance expected 2H 2026

traps.relegate_if: ≥2 of: TWST ops miss on Q4 adj. EBITDA; TEM–PSNL deal break; TXG/ILMN guide cuts while top weights; dilution cascade across clinical sleeve; sustained fund outflows into weakness.
sources: Company IR / 10-Q for TWST, TEM, CRSP, NTLA, BEAM

traps.title: Buyback as confession — captive duration
traps.status_note: Sep 9 10Y + Sep 10 30Y both STAMPED strong private sponsorship (RELEGATE pressure); Sep 10 $6bn 10–20Y buyback accepted $5.187bn / offered $10.489bn (86.5% of max). validation_status remains WATCH — JG.
traps.who_collects_rent: Whoever is forced or structurally bid to warehouse long-end duration (banks/pensions under repression; issuer as standing long-end bid via enlarged buybacks) while coupon supply continues.
traps.leftover: Narratives that treat buybacks as one-off 'support' while private sponsorship of the long end remains thin.
traps.decisive_test: Sep 9 10Y STAMPED (PASS); Sep 10 30Y STAMPED (PASS); Sep 10 $6bn buyback op: $5.187bn accepted / $10.489bn offered (86.5% of max; 23/40 issues); Nov 4 QRA buyback maxes.

next_datapoint.label: Nov 4 2026 Quarterly Refunding buyback sizes. Sep 9 10Y + Sep 10 30Y STAMPED strong; Sep 10 buyback $5.187bn/$6bn max accepted ($10.489bn offered).

traps.relegate_if: Strong private auction sponsorship makes buybacks cosmetic; or Nov 4 refunding cuts buyback sizes so the structural state-bid claim dies.
